requirement.description: The UUID storage implementation has issues with looking up external files. When files are not found in the expected locations, the lookup process throws KeyError instead of properly handling missing files or finding them in alternative locations. This affects tests that rely on UUID-based external storage.
requirement.contract: The UUID storage should properly handle file lookups for UUID-based external files, including fallback mechanisms when files aren't found in primary locations, and ensure the _external_files cache is properly populated with all relevant UUID files.

requirement.description: The external() function fails with AttributeError when comparing bytes objects because it attempts to call .items() method on bytes objects during comparison operations. This happens in the __eq__ method when dealing with bytes values that don't have the .items() method.
requirement.contract: The external() function should properly handle bytes objects in comparisons without attempting to call .items() on them, and should correctly compare bytes with bytes values.

requirement.description: The format handler registration mechanism doesn't properly initialize default formats. The TextFormat and BinaryFormat classes are not being registered in the global state's all_formats dictionary during startup, causing KeyError when accessing format handlers for certain suffixes.
requirement.contract: All default format handlers (TextFormat, BinaryFormat) should be automatically registered in the global state's all_formats dictionary during initialization, ensuring they're available when external() functions are called.
